issue.title: Remote-attention dismissals are lost once compaction archives the dismissed row

task_type_fields.impact:
Users see remote-attention rows they already dismissed come back as unread every few
days while the remote request stays pending, which undercuts sase-168.1's "dismissal
sticks for its revision" guarantee. Fix belongs in sase-core: either keep dismissed rows
owned by an inventory reconciler in the live store while their request is still listed,
or record a dismissal tombstone that reconcile consults. Then move the sase pin.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by phase sase-1tz.4.1.3 (attention_key) note #2; filed by the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent.

Root cause: sase-core notification compaction archives a dismissed row once its latest
activity is older than 3 days (moves it to `notifications-archive.jsonl`). The
remote-attention reconciler (`reconcile_remote_attention_inbox` in
`src/sase/dispatch/attention_inbox.py`, via sase-core `reconcile_notification_rows`)
only consults the live `notifications.jsonl`. So when a remote request is still pending at
the same revision after its dismissed row was archived, the next reconcile recreates the
row as a fresh, unread, undismissed row. A user dismissal therefore only sticks for its
revision while the row is still in the live store.

Evidence (athena, read-only, 2026-11-20): notification id
`23bf34b3-82d3-5d60-a9bf-f4e207c9172f` appears twice in `notifications-archive.jsonl`
for one revision (archived, recreated, dismissed again).

Repro sketch: dismiss a remote-attention row for a still-pending request; age it past the
3-day archive window and run compaction; run the remote-attention reconcile with the
same revision; the row comes back unread.

This predates epic sase-1tz.4.1 (the old per-revision key had the same gap); the epic's
stable `(origin, request_id)` key does not change it.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1tz.4.1.3 found that archived remote-attention dismissals resurface as unread rows; the sase-1tz.4.1 land agent is filing its proposed follow-up.

payload.description: Both change reconcile_remote_attention_inbox in src/sase/dispatch/attention_inbox.py; coordinate edits
